data.name: Iris-Z
data.description: Iris-Z is a FLUX.2-based joint RGB and depth model. Generate an image from text, create RGB with a matching depth visualization and float32 log-depth array, estimate depth from one image, or generate from a square depth map. Text generation supports up to 1,310,720 pixels with 16-pixel increments. Depth-guided output is square at 512 or 1024 pixels. Prompts are limited to 4096 characters and truncated to 512 encoder tokens.

route.note: NanoGPT route-level validation before provider submission.

provider.note: NanoGPT supports Iris-Z input edges up to 2048px; depth-guided generation currently requires a square depth map.

data.name: Topaz Image Upscale
data.description: Topaz Image Upscale enlarges one image with precision, generative, or creative algorithms. Choose Standard, High Fidelity, Low Resolution, CGI, Text Refine, Wonder, Recover, Standard MAX, Redefine, Detail, or Bloom variants. Use 1–4× scaling or an aspect-preserving 2K, 4K, or 8K target area within 1–6× enlargement per edge; actual dimensions may be rounded. Wonder 4 and Detail require a target size. Accepts one still PNG, JPEG, or WebP up to 40 MP and 30 MiB; output is limited to 100 MP in JPEG or PNG.

pricing.target_integer_scale_tariff: Targets exactly matching an integer 1–4× scale use the scale tariff where that algorithm supports scale mode.

prompt_length.notes: Optional; supported only by Bloom algorithms in target mode.

route.note: NanoGPT route-level validation before provider submission.

provider.note: One still image, up to 40 MP input and 100 MP output.

data.name: Morgana v1.2
data.description: Generate one 1024×1024 PNG from a text prompt. Choose low (10 steps), medium (20 steps, default), or high (32 steps) quality, and optionally set a seed. Text-to-image only.

data.name: MOSS Image
data.description: MOSS Image by OpenMOSS generates images from natural-language prompts, tag sequences, or serialized JSON layouts, with Chinese and English text rendering and control over text placement and object arrangement. Create 1–4 images per request in JPEG, PNG, or WebP, with dimensions from 512 to 2048 pixels per side aligned to multiples of 16. Optional prompt expansion plans a structured layout and falls back to your original prompt if unavailable. Supports negative prompts, 1–100 steps, guidance from 0 to 10, and reproducible seeds. Text-to-image only.

data.name: GPT Image 2.6 Flare
data.description: GPT Image 2.6 Flare generates images from text and edits images with up to 16 references. Designed for fast iteration. Choose low, medium, or high complexity independently of five quality levels, with 1K, 2K, or 4K output and 15 aspect ratios. Custom pixel sizes are also supported through the API. Supports PNG, JPEG, WebP, transparent PNG/WebP backgrounds, and transparent PNG markup annotations for regional edits through the API. Also generates animated GIFs from a prompt or from reference images. Prices are estimated before generation and settled from actual token usage.

pricing.estimate_note: Per-image tier estimates cover square image output at high quality (the most expensive aspect ratio). Request quotes add conservative prompt and reference allowances; a GIF is priced as the single frame sheet OpenAI renders and bills for each animation. Final billing uses returned token usage. Complexity has no separate fee. Cached input rates apply only when cached token counts are reported.
